title: Desktop website in context
slide_intent: Show a digital composition at a plausible viewing distance because layouts must be legible outside isolated mockups.
strategic_value: The paired artwork and colored panels can carry Dropbox’s campaign language onto a desk screen.
demonstration: A desktop monitor on a white desk displays a burgundy-and-blue page with text and two joined abstract images.
practical_value: Compare text scale, image balance and surrounding whitespace in a physical screen context.

content_islands.spec: Keep the campaign text left of the paired image within the monitor.

content_islands.spec: Retain the white workspace, drawing tools, plant and orange chair.
